# Trap Wars - Ray Character Brief

## Role

Ray has neighborhood experience, access, information advantage, confidence, and relaxed authority. He knows who is moving what, where demand is shifting, and who can get things done. He supports the game's educational metaphor without reading as a generic dealer NPC, quest giver, parody, or movie gangster.

## Visual Direction

- Grounded semi-realism matching Hero and the current world.
- Suggested age range: early-30s to mid-40s; visibly more established and experienced than Hero.
- Calm posture, measured eye contact, low-effort control, and credible listening behavior.
- Distinct body proportions, facial structure, hair, wardrobe construction, palette, footwear, and accessories.
- Quality casual layers with practical sophistication; restrained watch/ring/accessory cues; no giant logos or costume wealth.
- Original fashion only; no brand/team marks, celebrity likeness, weapons, or stereotypical crime costume.

## Performance Priority

Ray is the priority facial/dialogue character for Day 1. His face must support skepticism, thought, concern, restrained approval, and conversational warmth. The design must hold up in medium close-up under Day and Night lighting.

## Technical Delivery

- Same FBX/source, Unity Humanoid, hierarchy, scale, topology, LOD, material, and texture standards as Hero.
- LOD0 45k-80k triangles; LOD1 near 50%; LOD2 near 20%; maximum four skinned renderers preferred.
- Complete facial inventory per `FACIAL_RIG_SPEC.md`, including usable visemes where contracted.
- Eye/head aim compatibility and stable jaw/mouth deformation; no facial mesh intersections at contracted extremes.
- Dialogue-ready Animator compatibility and authored clips from `ANIMATION_BRIEF.md`.
- Delivery manifest and third-party/license inventory.

## Evaluation Package

Provide one production-candidate Ray mesh with textures, rig, LOD sample, blink, jaw, brows, smile, skepticism, concern/thought, and viseme proof. Include the Ray explaining test clip. It will be reviewed front, three-quarter, Day, Night, and dialogue pose.

## Art Acceptance

Target 4/5 minimum for design, face, rig, materials, and performance. Hero and Ray must be identifiable without labels. Owner approval of Ray Visual and Art Style Match is mandatory.
